</div></div><div class="site-inner"><div class="content-sidebar-wrap"><main class="content" id="genesis-content"><article class="post-102780 post type-post status-publish format-standard has-post-thumbnail category-restaurant-interior-design category-studio-fils tag-hospitality tag-jamie-lau-photography tag-london tag-restaurant tag-soho tag-studio-fils tag-vegan entry"><header class="entry-header"><h2 class="entry-title"><a class="entry-title-link" href="https://homeworlddesign.com/kolamba-restaurant-in-soho-london-studio-fils/" rel="bookmark">Kolamba Restaurant in Soho, London / Studio Fils</a></h2>
<p class="entry-meta"><time class="entry-time">October 23, 2019</time> </p></header><div class="entry-content"><a aria-hidden="true" class="entry-image-link" href="https://homeworlddesign.com/kolamba-restaurant-in-soho-london-studio-fils/" tabindex="-1"><img alt="Kolamba Restaurant in Soho, London / Studio Fils" class="post-image entry-image" height="590" sizes="(max-width: 880px) 100vw, 880px" src="https://homeworlddesign.com/wp-content/uploads/2019/10/Kolamba-Restaurant-3.jpg" srcset="https://homeworlddesign.com/wp-content/uploads/2019/10/Kolamba-Restaurant-3.jpg 880w, https://homeworlddesign.com/wp-content/uploads/2019/10/Kolamba-Restaurant-3-298x200.jpg 298w, https://homeworlddesign.com/wp-content/uploads/2019/10/Kolamba-Restaurant-3-597x400.jpg 597w, https://homeworlddesign.com/wp-content/uploads/2019/10/Kolamba-Restaurant-3-800x536.jpg 800w" width="880"/></a><p>Kolamba restaurant is the latest and greenest Sri Lankan sensation to hit Soho. The Kolamba restaurant is next door to Dishoom, on Kingly Street in the Carnaby area of Soho, and diners are treated to a space like no other in Soho.</p>
</div><footer class="entry-footer"><p class="entry-meta"></p></footer></article><article class="post-102764 post type-post status-publish format-standard has-post-thumbnail category-modern-apartments category-neil-davies-architects tag-chelsea tag-japanese-inspiration tag-neil-davies-architects tag-remodel tag-south-west-london tag-two-bedroom-apartment entry"><header class="entry-header"><h2 class="entry-title"><a class="entry-title-link" href="https://homeworlddesign.com/culford-gardens-two-bedroom-apartment-in-chelsea-london/" rel="bookmark">Culford Gardens Two-Bedroom Apartment in Chelsea, London</a></h2>
<p class="entry-meta"><time class="entry-time">October 23, 2019</time> </p></header><div class="entry-content"><a aria-hidden="true" class="entry-image-link" href="https://homeworlddesign.com/culford-gardens-two-bedroom-apartment-in-chelsea-london/" tabindex="-1"><img alt="Culford Gardens Two-Bedroom Apartment in Chelsea, London" class="post-image entry-image" height="659" sizes="(max-width: 880px) 100vw, 880px" src="https://homeworlddesign.com/wp-content/uploads/2019/10/Culford-Gardens-1.jpg" srcset="https://homeworlddesign.com/wp-content/uploads/2019/10/Culford-Gardens-1.jpg 880w, https://homeworlddesign.com/wp-content/uploads/2019/10/Culford-Gardens-1-267x200.jpg 267w, https://homeworlddesign.com/wp-content/uploads/2019/10/Culford-Gardens-1-534x400.jpg 534w, https://homeworlddesign.com/wp-content/uploads/2019/10/Culford-Gardens-1-800x599.jpg 800w" width="880"/></a><p>The client’s brief called for a two-bedroom apartment that had the spirit and sophistication of traditional and contemporary Japanese architecture without reverting to pastiche.</p>
</div><footer class="entry-footer"><p class="entry-meta"></p></footer></article><article class="post-102744 post type-post status-publish format-standard has-post-thumbnail category-brereton-architects category-office-design tag-architects tag-brereton-architects tag-headquarter tag-interior-design tag-nicholas-swan-photography tag-office-2 tag-peer-to-peer-lending-company tag-united-states tag-utah tag-workplace tag-workstation-clusters entry"><header class="entry-header"><h2 class="entry-title"><a class="entry-title-link" href="https://homeworlddesign.com/lendingclub-headquarter-in-lehi-utah-brereton-architects/" rel="bookmark">LendingClub Headquarter in Lehi, Utah / Brereton Architects</a></h2>
<p class="entry-meta"><time class="entry-time">October 23, 2019</time> </p></header><div class="entry-content"><a aria-hidden="true" class="entry-image-link" href="https://homeworlddesign.com/lendingclub-headquarter-in-lehi-utah-brereton-architects/" tabindex="-1"><img alt="LendingClub Headquarter in San Francisco, California / Brereton" class="post-image entry-image" height="587" sizes="(max-width: 880px) 100vw, 880px" src="https://homeworlddesign.com/wp-content/uploads/2019/10/LendingClub-Headquarter-2.jpg" srcset="https://homeworlddesign.com/wp-content/uploads/2019/10/LendingClub-Headquarter-2.jpg 880w, https://homeworlddesign.com/wp-content/uploads/2019/10/LendingClub-Headquarter-2-300x200.jpg 300w, https://homeworlddesign.com/wp-content/uploads/2019/10/LendingClub-Headquarter-2-600x400.jpg 600w, https://homeworlddesign.com/wp-content/uploads/2019/10/LendingClub-Headquarter-2-800x534.jpg 800w" width="880"/></a><p>LendingClub is a US peer to peer lending company, headquartered in San Francisco, California. As the company continued to grow and evolve, they engaged Brereton Architects to open a satellite campus in Lehi, Utah</p>
</div><footer class="entry-footer"><p class="entry-meta"></p></footer></article><article class="post-102726 post type-post status-publish format-standard has-post-thumbnail category-caaht-studio-architects category-country-houses category-vacation-houses tag-caaht-studio-architects tag-cabin tag-dave-olsen-photography tag-fireplace tag-new-zealand tag-retreat tag-shelter tag-sliding-screens entry"><header class="entry-header"><h2 class="entry-title"><a class="entry-title-link" href="https://homeworlddesign.com/matarangi-cabins-caaht-studio-architects/" rel="bookmark">Matarangi Cabins / CAAHT Studio Architects</a></h2>
<p class="entry-meta"><time class="entry-time">October 22, 2019</time> </p></header><div class="entry-content"><a aria-hidden="true" class="entry-image-link" href="https://homeworlddesign.com/matarangi-cabins-caaht-studio-architects/" tabindex="-1"><img alt="Matarangi Cabins / CAAHT Studio Architects" class="post-image entry-image" height="587" sizes="(max-width: 880px) 100vw, 880px" src="https://homeworlddesign.com/wp-content/uploads/2019/10/Matarangi-Cabins-1.jpg" srcset="https://homeworlddesign.com/wp-content/uploads/2019/10/Matarangi-Cabins-1.jpg 880w, https://homeworlddesign.com/wp-content/uploads/2019/10/Matarangi-Cabins-1-300x200.jpg 300w, https://homeworlddesign.com/wp-content/uploads/2019/10/Matarangi-Cabins-1-600x400.jpg 600w, https://homeworlddesign.com/wp-content/uploads/2019/10/Matarangi-Cabins-1-800x534.jpg 800w" width="880"/></a><p>A new holiday house comprising of two simple gable cabin forms at Matarangi, Coromandel. Designed within an existing clearing amongst the pine trees on their site near the beach to provide various degrees of shelter</p>
</div><footer class="entry-footer"><p class="entry-meta"></p></footer></article><article class="post-102708 post type-post status-publish format-standard has-post-thumbnail category-adam-scott-photography category-fraher-architects category-renovations tag-fraher-findlay tag-fraher-architects tag-house tag-interior-design tag-london tag-refurbishment tag-renovation tag-united-kingdom entry"><header class="entry-header"><h2 class="entry-title"><a class="entry-title-link" href="https://homeworlddesign.com/the-christmas-house-fraher-architects/" rel="bookmark">The Christmas House / Fraher Architects</a></h2>
<p class="entry-meta"><time class="entry-time">October 22, 2019</time> </p></header><div class="entry-content"><a aria-hidden="true" class="entry-image-link" href="https://homeworlddesign.com/the-christmas-house-fraher-architects/" tabindex="-1"><img alt="The Christmas House" class="post-image entry-image" height="587" sizes="(max-width: 880px) 100vw, 880px" src="https://homeworlddesign.com/wp-content/uploads/2019/10/The-Christmas-House-12.jpg" srcset="https://homeworlddesign.com/wp-content/uploads/2019/10/The-Christmas-House-12.jpg 880w, https://homeworlddesign.com/wp-content/uploads/2019/10/The-Christmas-House-12-300x200.jpg 300w, https://homeworlddesign.com/wp-content/uploads/2019/10/The-Christmas-House-12-600x400.jpg 600w, https://homeworlddesign.com/wp-content/uploads/2019/10/The-Christmas-House-12-800x534.jpg 800w" width="880"/></a><p>The Christmas House is a refurbishment of a turn of the century house built by Ted Christmas. The use of colour focuses on the earthy tones of the period, reinstated throughout the house and to the facade.</p>
</div><footer class="entry-footer"><p class="entry-meta"></p></footer></article><article class="post-102696 post type-post status-publish format-standard has-post-thumbnail category-concrete-amsterdam category-restaurant-interior-design tag-beach-club tag-chantal-arnts-photography tag-concrete tag-curacao tag-hospitality tag-pool-bar tag-restaurant tag-steel-structure entry"><header class="entry-header"><h2 class="entry-title"><a class="entry-title-link" href="https://homeworlddesign.com/restaurant-020-a-historic-manor-house-is-transformed-into-a-restaurant-and-beach-club/" rel="bookmark">Restaurant 020 – A Historic Manor House is Transformed into a Restaurant and Beach Club</a></h2>
<p class="entry-meta"><time class="entry-time">October 21, 2019</time> </p></header><div class="entry-content"><a aria-hidden="true" class="entry-image-link" href="https://homeworlddesign.com/restaurant-020-a-historic-manor-house-is-transformed-into-a-restaurant-and-beach-club/" tabindex="-1"><img alt="Restaurant 020 - A Historic Manor House is Transformed into a Restaurant and Beach Club" class="post-image entry-image" height="587" sizes="(max-width: 880px) 100vw, 880px" src="https://homeworlddesign.com/wp-content/uploads/2019/10/Restaurant-020-6.jpg" srcset="https://homeworlddesign.com/wp-content/uploads/2019/10/Restaurant-020-6.jpg 880w, https://homeworlddesign.com/wp-content/uploads/2019/10/Restaurant-020-6-300x200.jpg 300w, https://homeworlddesign.com/wp-content/uploads/2019/10/Restaurant-020-6-600x400.jpg 600w, https://homeworlddesign.com/wp-content/uploads/2019/10/Restaurant-020-6-800x534.jpg 800w" width="880"/></a><p>A historic manor house is transformed into a restaurant and beach club. Conceptually, the new venue follows the same principles of restaurant 212 in Amsterdam, featuring ‘no table seating’, an open kitchen with bar-height seating directing the guests’ focus on the chefs, stimulating interaction.</p>
</div><footer class="entry-footer"><p class="entry-meta"></p></footer></article><div class="archive-pagination pagination"><ul><li class="active"><a aria-current="page" aria-label="Current page" href="https://homeworlddesign.com/"><span class="screen-reader-text">Page </span>1</a></li>
